ov: مكان هادئ (الإنجليزية: A Quiet Place) هو فيلم رعب خارق للطبيعة أمريكي، من إخراج جون كراسينسكي. الفيلم من بطولة جون كراسينسكي وإيميلي بلنت.صدر الفيلم في 6 أبريل، 2018 من طرف باراماونت بيكتشرز.
plotEn:
Sightless aliens with sharp hearing and impenetrable armored skin have taken over the planet and killed most of the human population. The Abbott family – father Lee, mother Evelyn, deaf daughter Regan, and sons Marcus and Beau – live on their isolated farm in a forest in Millbrook, New York, and have survived by taking precautions such as laying sand paths to avoid stepping on crunching leaves and using American Sign Language when communicating.
When the family goes into the nearby town for supplies, Beau finds a toy Space Shuttle, but Lee takes out the batteries and makes him leave it behind due to the noise it would make if powered on. Regan returns the toy to Beau without its batteries, but he takes the batteries without anyone noticing. While walking home, Beau activates the toy, which starts making noise. Almost immediately, Beau is killed by a nearby alien. Regan suffers terrible guilt after Beau's death. 
Over a year later, Evelyn is pregnant with a fourth child. Lee is trying to build a working hearing aid for Regan, but can't master the electronics; the attempt causes a high-pitched noise but does not improve hearing. Marcus reluctantly goes fishing with Lee while Regan, upset that she cannot go, visits Beau's grave. While the rest of the family is away, Evelyn goes into labor.
